Discover Wholesale Wheat Grass Powder

Wheat grass powder is made from young wheat shoots, dried and milled into a fine green powder. Tradenest Naturals supplies wholesale wheat grass powder to food, beverage and supplement brands abroad. We use gentle dehydration to keep the bright green colour and fresh, grassy taste. As a wheat grass powder supplier in India, we help brands build green blends with a steady, simple ingredient. The young shoots are cut at an early stage of growth. Next, we wash, sort and dehydrate them under controlled conditions. The dried grass is then milled and sieved to an even texture. This careful handling is why brands choose us over other wheat grass powder manufacturers when they want consistent colour and taste from lot to lot. Ask us for a sample to compare.

Manufacturing and Quality Practices

Our processing follows the food hygiene practices required under our FSSAI licence. Each lot is checked for colour, aroma, texture and moisture before packing. As a wheat grass powder exporter India, we share a product specification sheet with every quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. The powder is dehydrated and milled to 80-100 mesh. This fine particle size mixes well into water, juices and shakes. We keep lot records from raw material to export packing, so every bag can be traced back to its batch. Your team gets clear information for its own formulation work.

Key Manufacturing Highlights:

  • Raw material carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers
  • Hygienic washing and controlled dehydration
  • Fine milling and sieving to 80-100 mesh
  • Specification sheet with every quotation; third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost

Flexible Commercial Terms and Bulk Supply

Want to know about pricing and order terms? We quote a competitive bulk wheat grass powder price for distributors and FMCG brands. Our MOQ is 5 Kg, which works for growing brands and larger industrial buyers alike. You can request a custom quote or sample through our sales desk. We also offer OEM and private label packing. Whether you need retail pouches or export drums, we can pack to your brief. As an IEC registered exporter, we give export documentation support and ship worldwide from India. Contact our export desk to discuss your volumes.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for wholesale wheat grass powder?

Our MOQ is 5 Kg. Private label runs are quoted separately based on your packaging. Contact us for a tailored quote.

What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, purity)?

Our standard powder is dehydrated, with an 80-100 mesh size and moisture at or below 5.0%. It is plain wheat grass with no added fillers or colours.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We pack in food-grade foil pouches, HDPE containers and export drums. Stored in cool, dry conditions, the shelf life is 24 months.

How do I request a sample or place a trial order?

Send a quote request through our website. Our sales team will reply with sample availability and freight options.

Standards & references

  • DGFT: Directorate General of Foreign Trade, India (IEC registration)
  • FSSAI: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
